data.long_meaning: The name Yogitha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Yogita', meaning 'Divine Woman'. This name is often used to refer to goddesses associated with yoga, meditation, and spiritual growth. The name Yogitha carries the meaning “Divine Woman” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Yogitha usually hope their child will grow to embody divine woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
